name: seal_confirm
audit_status: T0 procedural confirmation visual approved by director after native PlayMode receipt and code review; performance, readability and G4/G5 unmeasured; audio disabled
presentation_intent: A restrained ink mark communicates that the current confirmation was durably saved.

trigger.binding_status: VERIFIED:T0 native PlayMode receipt hook and Update clock

contract_ack.systems: 2026-09-10: tCommitReceipt(attemptId, commandId, contextGeneration, success); only the current successful save attempt emits once
contract_ack.presentation: _workspace/current/presentation/t0-circuit-vfx-review.md: 300 ms stamp envelope and +150 ms impact marker ACK
contract_ack.runtime_verification_scope: Save-success/stale/failure event path, timed ink visibility, duplicate/reduced-motion suppression and UI context-exit cleanup

required_guards: receipt matches the current pending attempt, command and context generation
receipt has not already emitted a confirmation
current result context is still active
trigger.on_context_exit: Invalidate pending presentation token; cancel visual/audio playback and clear the layer without changing saved state.
trigger.on_pause: Pause the shared presentation clock; do not accumulate or replay confirmation sounds.
trigger.deduplication: Consume each accepted presentation token once; re-entering a panel does not replay it.

markers.event: seal_confirm ink mark and optional SFX_stamp_down

layers.depth_order: behind result text; outside tool lines and interactive controls
layers.geometry: One clipped, preallocated UI ink mark. No bloom, flash, glow, shake or expanding particles.
layers.visibility: Hidden before stamp_impact; static from impact until envelope end. Persistent success text/checkmark belongs to UI, not this transient layer.

reduced_motion.behavior: At the same accepted successful receipt show only the static UI success label/checkmark; skip the stamp transform and transient ink layer. Keep identical receipt, stale-callback and deduplication guards. No flash or shake.
reduced_motion.audio: If enabled and audited, emit the same single confirmation cue at accepted receipt; never during SavePending. No deferred duplicate.

low_quality.behavior: Use the same static label/checkmark fallback as reduced motion.

sound_cue.asset_status: Original Higgsfield candidate remains disabled and separately unaudited; this visual approval does not authorize audio playback.
sound_cue.missing_asset_behavior: Remain silent; preserve the static visual confirmation.

native_playmode.capture_step_meaning: Deterministic Unity Time.captureDeltaTime test input, not observed frame time or a performance measurement
verified_behaviors: save failure emits no success and retry emits once
Update/Time.deltaTime follows +150ms ink marker and 300ms envelope
failed and duplicate presentations produce no new ink
reduced-motion presentation produces no transient ink
actual UI ScreenChanged clears active ink

approval_scope: Only the existing T0 procedural confirmation ink/checkmark and verified receipt/clock path. No audio, other effects, campaign release or performance gate promotion.

runtime_implementation.placement: ScreenSpaceOverlay canvas sortingOrder 30, normalized anchor (0.955, 0.15), 48 by 42 UI units
runtime_implementation.presentation_clock: Update advances Time.deltaTime; no ink before 0.15s, ink from 0.15s until <0.3s, then Clear
